The *Mohapariññā Sutta* (Iti 11; PTS It 6) is a short discourse preserved in the *Ekakanipāta* of the *Itivuttaka*. The text teaches that when the mind is cleansed of passion for delusion and abandons it, one is capable of putting an end to suffering.
